verdict.rationale: Steel documents built-in Managed Residential Proxies and Bring Your Own Proxy. Stealth is named only in a one-line product tagline, with no documented fingerprinting controls. Geo-targeting of proxies is not evidenced at all, so the proxy half is well supported but the stealth-fingerprinting half is thin. Missing for 10: documented stealth fingerprint configuration (user-agent/fingerprint randomization details), geo-targeted proxy selection by country/region, and independent or hands-on evidence that sessions avoid bot detection.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots

citations.quote: Steel offers two powerful ways to use proxies: our built-in **Managed Residential Proxies** or connecting to your own proxy provider with our **Bring Your Own Proxy (BYOP)** feature.
managed cloud browsers with stealth, residential proxies, CAPTCHA solving
It appears you can set your own proxies to not use their cloud.
